messages:
maya_docs: Opening a quick thread before I submit a docs PR about how we describe retention behavior during tenant migration (SOC2/audit logs). Need to align snippets and legal phrasing.
jon_security: thanks. we should pick a single phrase: 'tenant migration' is fine. avoid 're-homed' in customer-facing text.
maya_docs: noted. Draft plan: update the audit logs page with a short FAQ, a python SDK snippet, a curl export example, and contract-friendly wording about exports and legal holds.
liam_engineering: for SDK examples use v2 names: `set_retention_policy` and `holds.create`. show that holds return an id and block TTL expiry.
sara_legal: add this sentence to the docs: "During tenant migration, audit logs remain subject to the tenant's configured retention policy unless a legal hold is applied; exports remain the responsibility of the exporter and must be secured per contract."
maya_docs: will include that verbatim. Draft snippet (py + curl) below  please check accuracy.
```
# python
from redwood import AuditClient, HoldsClient
audit = AuditClient(api_key="$REDWOOD_KEY")
audit.set_retention_policy(tenant_id="acct_123", ttl_days=90)
hold = HoldsClient(api_key="$REDWOOD_KEY").create(tenant_id="acct_123", reason="M&A legal review")
print("hold id:", hold.id)
```

```
# curl: export logs (optional redaction)
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/audit/exports \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -d '{"tenant_id":"acct_123","from":"2025-01-01","to":"2025-03-01","redact_sensitive":true}'
```
liam_engineering: that looks good. small tweak: export endpoint is `/v1/audit/exports` but the redaction flag is `redact_sensitive` only for async exports; mention exports may take minutes.
maya_docs: added note: "Exports are asynchronous and may take several minutes to complete; exported files are encrypted in transit and at rest."
docs-bot: link-checker: scanned PR branch  found 2 internal anchors missing and one external vendor link changed.
maya_docs: fixing anchors and swapping vendor link. assigning reviewers: @jon_security @sara_legal @liam_engineering. PR will include an FAQ bullet: 
- "What happens to logs when a tenant migrates?" with 3 bullets: retention follows tenant policy, legal holds override TTL, exports are customer's responsibility.
jon_security: approve once the anchors are fixed and the export encryption sentence is present.
sara_legal: lgtm for legal phrasing. consider adding a short sample contract clause for enterprise customers in a separate 'legal' appendix.
maya_docs: will file a follow-up PR for contract language. Opening PR now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/503. last_message_ts: 1765432250
